summary: Settings: the values, overrides and switches of a style, project or item, and the taste profile it uses.

commands.name: settings.set
commands.summary: Set one setting in a scope

params.name: scope
params.help: The scope: style:<id>, project:<id> or item:<id>; a taste profile changes only by keep as default.

params.name: key
params.help: The setting's dotted key, for example melody.weights.melodic.

params.name: value
params.help: The value: a number, true or false, a word, n/d or a list.

commands.reply: The scope's content after the change.
commands.example: settings.set scope item:itm-1 key melody.keep value 3

commands.name: settings.unset
commands.summary: Take one setting out of a scope

params.name: scope
params.help: The scope: style:<id>, project:<id> or item:<id>.

commands.reply: The scope's content after the change.

commands.name: settings.import
commands.summary: Set the settings of a document in a scope

params.name: scope
params.help: The scope: taste:<name>, style:<id>, project:<id> or item:<id>.

params.name: document
params.help: A preferences document: its members are flattened to dotted keys.

params.name: replace
params.help: True drops the scope's settings that the document does not hold.

params.name: note
params.help: Why; required for a taste profile, which records it with who and when.

commands.reply: The scope's content after the change.
commands.example:
settings.import scope taste:none note "taste-profile.md none"
  document
    melody
      keep 3

commands.name: settings.override
commands.summary: Waive, reverse, reweight or switch off a rule in a project or item

params.name: scope
params.help: The scope: project:<id> or item:<id>; overrides go on a project, an item or a request, never in a profile.

params.name: rule
params.help: The rule: a soft rule group or a hard rule of the melody stage.

params.name: action
params.help: What to do with it; clear removes the rule's override.

params.name: weight
params.help: The weight of a reweight, 0 to 20.

commands.reply: The scope's content after the change.
commands.example: settings.override scope item:itm-1 rule parallel-fifths action waive

commands.name: settings.switch
commands.summary: Switch scopes off for a project or an item

params.name: off
params.help: The scopes to skip: style, taste or project (an item only); replaces the list.

commands.reply: The scope's content after the change.

commands.name: settings.use-taste
commands.summary: Name the taste profile a style, project or item uses

params.name: scope
params.help: The scope: style:<id>, project:<id> or item:<id>.

params.name: taste
params.help: The profile's name; absent clears it.

commands.reply: The scope's content after the change.
